Scoping the room before committing to anyone
Hanging back at the edges till I find my person

culture.description: You go deep, not wide. You're in the museum before it opens and the local spot after it closes.
culture.insight: You don't just visit places — you actually learn them. Pair you with someone who matches that pace, not someone who wants to rush you through.

social.description: You came for one thing and stayed for the people. You know everyone's name by day two.
social.insight: A room of strangers doesn't scare you — it's basically an invitation. We'll keep your feed full of people and plans, not just places.

night.description: Things reveal themselves after dark and you know it. Mornings are for recovery.
night.insight: We'll weight your matches toward people who don't expect a reply before noon.

food.description: You plan your days around meals, and you'll take the long way for the right place.
food.insight: Your matches will skew toward people who treat a good meal as the whole point of the day, not a pit stop.

adventure.description: No plan is the plan. You decide late, travel light, and somehow always find the right people.
adventure.insight: Rigid itineraries make you twitchy. We'll surface the loose, see-where-it-goes plans first.

wellness.description: Slow, intentional, unbothered. You need at least one afternoon with absolutely nothing planned.
wellness.insight: You recharge in quiet, not chaos. We'll lean your matches toward people who won't fill every hour.

completeCard.completeBody: All three pieces are in — your matches are as sharp as they get.
completeCard.almostBody: Each piece makes your matches sharper. Add them now, or they fill in as you travel and join things.
completeCard.travelDesc: Pace, budget, how you travel — sharpens trip matches
completeCard.eventDesc: What you want from a night out, group size — sharpens local plans
completeCard.unlockBody: Finish all three to get the complete read on who you are.
